prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada the first time that The Toronto Maple Leafs won The Stanley Cup?
answer:
The first time the **Toronto Maple Leafs** won the Stanley Cup—under that name—was in **1932**, when **R. B. Bennett** was Prime Minister of Canada.

*(The franchise’s earlier Toronto Arenas team won in 1918, when Sir Robert Borden was prime minister.)*
